description:
The biggest crisis for Han-Young, a top employee at a matchmaking company, since joining the company, is to get a gay married?! 

Han-Young, a top employee at a matchmaking company 'Marry Me' , is introduced to a client by his manager. Han-Young starts the meeting with high hopes that it could be a chance for promotion if the client gets married, but the client named Beom-Il does not cooperate at all and eventually writes down that he is homosexual in the information field. However, Han-Young cannot give up this opportunity easily and prepares for the next meeting even if he has to work overtime, but Beom-Il pretends not to know and eventually harasses Han-Young. Meanwhile, Beom-Il likes Han-young because he looks half-and-half... 

Will Han-Young be able to get Beom-Il married?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
